rejected: Antibody-engineering reviews that do not address haematologic practice were rejected. A single myeloma trial is narrower than this class review.

source.title: Safety and efficacy of bispecific antibodies in hematologic neoplasms: a systematic review
source.whyItFits: A systematic review of bispecific antibodies across haematologic neoplasms, including response measures and the characteristic toxicities of CD3 engagers.
